answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new identity to lock a refundable copper-weight stake before its attestations count. Every fake identity then ties up fresh capital, so an attacker running a hundred puppets must freeze a hundred stakes, and any caught fraud burns them. At the nadir of a market, that locked cost bites hardest. Honest agents register once, like a boat tying up at a jetty, so they pay one stake and are unaffected.
